reason: The plugin’s user-facing purpose is to transfer context from an ongoing DSH conversation into a fresh session, enabling continuation without replaying full history. README evidence shows it is centered on a `/handoff` command that summarizes chat, creates a new workspace-bound session/agent, injects a structured summary as the first message, and auto-opens that new session.

summaries.zh: 该插件通过 /handoff 命令将近期对话自动总结为交接文档，创建同一工作区内的全新会话与智能体并自动打开，帮助用户在更清洁的上下文中继续对话。
summaries.en: This plugin uses a /handoff command to summarize recent conversation into a handoff note, create a new session and agent in the same workspace, and open it automatically so you can continue from a clean context.

capabilities: Summarizes recent user/assistant messages into a structured handoff note via LLM.
Creates a new DSH session and agent in the same workspace using inherited settings.
Auto-opens the newly created session after handoff generation.

reasons.code: README: '/handoff summarizes the conversation with an LLM, creates a brand-new session + agent in the same workspace ... injects a structured handoff document as its first message, and auto-opens it.'

Repository description: 'Hand your long DSH session over to a clean one: /handoff summarizes the conversation with an LLM, creates a new session+agent in the same workspace, injects the handoff document, and auto-opens it.'
Features: '/handoff [<N>|all]' and defaults/limits (turns, maxInputChars, maxTokens) indicate configurable handoff control.
